headline: Three fresh faces crash the chart while DeepSeek keeps its grip on the crown
summary: Three newcomers landed at ranks 42, 50 and 51, and three models fell off the board, so the back of the leaderboard got a reshuffle. Up top, deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still holds first with 25.5% of tokens, and OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna is the day's climber, up five spots to sixth.
highlights: Biggest climber: openai/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 rose five places to 6th and is up 15 places over seven days.
Moonshot AI's kimi-k3.1-pro-20261023 is up 18 places over seven days, now 11th.
DeepSeek (37.1%) and OpenAI (10.8%) together hold 47.9% of tokens, with Zhipu AI close behind at 10.7%.
